**Claim text** (required)
<!-- The exact verbatim statement to be fact-checked. Quote it if it came from a specific source. -->


**Source where this claim appeared** (required)
<!-- URL, publication name, or description of where you saw this claim -->


**Category**
<!-- Choose one: science / politics / health / technology / economics / social / environment / history / media / law -->


**Why this claim matters** (optional)
<!-- Who is making this claim? Why should it be verified? What is at stake? -->


**Known debunking attempts** (optional)
<!-- Have you seen fact-checks of this already? Link them here so the editor can review before adding. -->
